traits: Blossom and Sprykin: Buffing the verticals here that you typically play with an Emblem so you don't feel like you need a reforger when you get a Blossom/Sprykin Emblem. For Spykin, we're also buffing the backline option as most players opt to buff their melee tank or an Emblem-toting Rengar.
Elderwood: Elderwood (9) continues to outperform our other verticals even while being Emblem and skill-dependent.

Kobuko and Rek'Sai: Ideally all our 1-costs have spots in various boards in the early and mid-game, but these two are often dropped from boards before we even get there. With these buffs we also expect the power floors of reroll Teemo and Veigar comps to be slightly higher as they often keep these champs around for longer.

Murkwolf: Brambleback's nerf hurt this puppy's comp. And since he's never been the primary carry on reroll Ravager or Riftbeast boards, there's plenty of room to buff pup in the ruff to be worth the chase.
Murkwolf Empowered Attack Damage: 65/100/160 AD ⇒ 65/100/180 AD

Malphite: Malphite's getting a better AP ratio on his shield and his ability's damage. While the ability damage shouldn't be too impactful, it might allow him to actually clean up a fight if your backliners got wrapped by a rogue Brambleback that's just made it out with a sliver of health.

Nidalee: AD Nidaless dies pretty fast to Ahri/Zyra boards, so increasing her survivability should allow her to cycle through casts more effectively. A stronger third cast should help get through those pesky frontliners she gets stuck on like the cat-nip stuffed punching bags they tend to be. Nidalee's AP form has yet to really emerge as a primary carry in a comp this set. This is our bigger buff for the patch (although it's still relatively small) with buffs to her javelin attacks and a bigger one to the final javelin. Keep a look out for AP Nidalee/Juggernaut comps in lobbies near you.

Sentinel: If you're not running Malphite, you're likely running Sentinel in AP flex lines. Both are in a tough spot to play as primary tanks, so for Sentinel we're increasing the shield HP ratio making item's like Warmog's that much better.

A lot of our combat Augments are strong, but Clockwork Accelerator and Plot Armor are not up to par with them.
Currently, Shopping Spree is our worst performing econ Prismatic on 2-1. Not by that much, but maybe by just one gold?
Unrivaled was hit hard by our Kha'Zix nerfs and it wasn't exactly meta before either. So we've got a real game changer of a buff for the duo here.
Unrivaled Rengar Heal Share: 25% ⇒ 50%Kha'Zix Mana Share: 50% ⇒ 70%

Emblems, especially when you can get multiple, can become powerful albeit situational win conditions. We're increasing the cost of Emblems with the Curio Cart to make them a bit bigger of an econ trade off.

Middle Path, which provides a shop full of two-star 3-costs is a situational yet high-powered Wisp. It's either great for your comp, or not worth the click already, but when it is great, it provides too much consistency for its cost.
